build_gradient_boosting_classifier: build a gradient boosting classifier for binary and multiclass classification with configurable loss functions
build_gradient_boosting_regressor: build a gradient boosting regressor for regression with squared error, absolute error, huber, or quantile loss
fit_gradient_boosting_ensemble: fit a gradient boosting ensemble with early stopping, subsampling, and learning rate control
predict_gradient_boosting_probabilities: predict class probabilities for gradient boosting classifier using log loss or exponential loss
compute_feature_importances: compute impurity-based feature importances from a fitted gradient boosting ensemble
